_doc:
IMPAIRMENT (Phase 065): an impaired resident is given a confidently wrong percept, and the truth goes only to the referee block. The percept is the Phase 062 perceiver's percept (world/perception.json); this table decides when and how it is made wrong.

SWITCH. IMPAIRMENT.enabled defaults to false. Off, the agent view is what it was before Phase 065. A game may override the switch, the strength and the sources with `game.impairment_scenario` (a dict with any of enabled, strength, sources). The percept needs PERCEPTION.enabled as well: with the perceiver off there is no percept to distort.

STRENGTH AND CAP. IMPAIRMENT.strength (0 to 1) scales every rate. The chance that one percept (or one heard utterance, or one quantity read) is distorted is 1 minus the product, over the active sources that apply, of (1 - strength x rate), capped at max_rate. Each rate is a step or a level of its DISTORTION row.

SOURCES. DISTORTION has one row per source. `measure` names the value the row reads (intoxication_band: the perceiver's band; fatigue: 1 minus the stamina reserve; illness: 1 when the resident is ill; light: the light the resident sees by). A row with `levels` maps a category to a rate. A row with `steps` maps a number to a rate: the last step whose threshold the measure reaches applies. `kinds` names the mechanisms the source may use, for each kind of thing that can be wrong: person, thing (the perceived subjects of Phase 062); utterance (a heard sentence, Phase 065b); quantity (a count or price a reader sees written, Phase 065b). A row names only the kinds it affects.

MECHANISMS. The way a percept or a heard sentence goes wrong.
- lower_tier: the percept drops one tier (a person becomes 'a person'; a thing becomes 'something').
- neighbour_stage: a person's life stage is replaced by a neighbouring stage (IMPAIRMENT_NEIGHBOURS).
- nearby_entity: the stage, job or kind is taken from another resident or thing in sight; a resident the observer knows by name is taken for another resident the observer also knows.
- mishear_word: one word of a heard sentence is swapped for a near word (IMPAIRMENT.mishearing, by sound or by sense), or a name in earshot is swapped for another name in earshot.
- shift_quantity: a count is read one unit off (a spelled number word in speech goes one word up or down; a written price goes one unit of its trade up or down, never below one unit). A count of one is never shifted down, because it would read as none.

WORDING. A distorted percept is made of the same tier templates as a true one, so it carries the same confidence: no hedge word is added. A distorted heard sentence is worded as the speaker said it, with the wrong word in it.

DETERMINISM. Each draw is a function of the world seed, the turn, the resident, the subject and a fixed label (domains/impairment.py). It uses no global random state. A simple listener holds no world reference, so its draws (speech only) are keyed to the listener, the turn and the utterance, not to the world seed.

NOT MODELLED. Fear and rage are not sources: the world has no fear or rage state (body mood is the only emotion number). Hallucination of a thing that is not there is not modelled.

APPROX. Every rate, step threshold, and max_rate is APPROX and authored: a plausible strength for a drunk, a tired, an ill or a dimly lit resident, not measured. The intoxication bands are the world's own (INTOXICATION.bands), and the fatigue, illness and light values are read from the world, not authored. IMPAIRMENT.mishearing is authored: the pairs are homophones or near-sounding words of the world's vocabulary, not a corpus count.

STAGE NEIGHBOURS. IMPAIRMENT_NEIGHBOURS lists, for each life stage (the keys of PERCEPTION.stage_nouns), the stages a person is most easily taken for. Authored.
